title: Bug 648535: Reprice subcontracting lines after scheduling
summary: Fixes repricing of subcontracting purchase lines in four cases: no matching price on carry-out, manually entered worksheet costs being overwritten, date edits on released orders failing, and lead-time-only rescheduling skipping repricing.
key_points: When no price matches, carry-out uses the standard subcontracting worksheet cost formula instead of the raw routing rate
Manually entered worksheet Direct Unit Cost is kept instead of being repriced
Financial repricing is skipped for non-open purchase orders, avoiding line-discount status errors on date edits
Planned-date repricing is keyed on the resulting Order Date so lead-time-only changes are repriced
Adds regression tests for these pricing and date-edit cases
quote: Detects whether the transferred worksheet value is the automatically selected price before repricing it
